title: Session B · Upper + hinge
notes: Updated by the coach each week; the weights here are the plan. Every set ends with 2 reps left in the tank. Four pairs: A1 then A2, rest, repeat.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: A1. Bench at about 30°. Elbows about 45° from your sides. (Last time: 25/30/35, 35 only got 8.)

exercises.name: Pull Up (Band)
exercises.note: A2. Band looped over the bar, foot or knee in it. Thick band first. If the bar isn't up yet, skip this and do the band row for 4 sets.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: B1. 35s, 3×10 this time. Hips back, dumbbells slide down your thighs, stop when the hamstrings pull.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Band)
exercises.note: B2. Stand on the band, hinge, pull to your hips. Back flat.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. The 5s. 8 lb was a lot last time; the weight goes up when 12 feels easy. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Band Pullaparts
exercises.note: D1. Arms straight, squeeze shoulder blades.
